subject: Request: Senior sign-off for one-time 35% hosted API retention credit
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <legal_ops@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Senior sign-off for one-time 35% hosted API retention credit

Team —

Quick background: NimbleHealth is a strategic ISV prospect who completed a 6-week pilot in March. They show strong product-market fit (500k tokens/month projected at ramp) but are hesitating to commit to our annual Hosted API contract due to price sensitivity and an internal budget review. Alex Gomez on the account has indicated risk of them walking to a lower-cost competitor unless we provide a one-time retention concession tied to an annual commit.

Why this matters:
- ARR upside: $420k ACV if they convert at the forecasted 500k token/month ramp over 12 months.
- Strategic: NimbleHealth is integrated with three regional health systems we view as valuable references in the payer segment.
- Timing: Legal & procurement want final terms by next Wednesday (2027-04-21) to meet their board procurement meeting.

Request:
- Approve a one-time, front-loaded 35% usage credit applied across the first three billable months post-contract signature (effectively reducing unit cost during ramp).
- Conditions: must take a 12-month commitment at the agreed volume bands; clause to revert to standard rates after the credit period.

Attachments: redlines and pricing model attached (see filenames). I included an alternate structure in tab 'Option B' that phases the credit off over 6 months (25% -> 15% -> 10%) if you prefer a ramp approach.

Why I think 35% vs. 25%: The competitive intel suggests the other vendor is offering an aggressive first-year rebate; NimbleHealth's procurement team explicitly asked for a concession in the 30–40% neighborhood. We risk losing both this logos and the three downstream system opportunities if we don't bend here.

Ask: Can we get senior sign-off (Markus or Mina) to proceed with the 35% structure, or should we table to Option B? I can join a short sync with finance/legal if helpful.

Thanks,

Stephanie Nguyen
Account Exec, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Senior sign-off for one-time 35% hosted API retention credit

+1 on moving quickly. Stephanie — strong ask and good rationale. A few data points for the signoff thread:
- We model net revenue (after credit) at ~$273k ARR for year one under the 35% (assuming full uptake).
- CAC payback is ~7 months with our current onboarding support plan; lifetime value looks favorable with expected expansion.

If legal signs off on the clause to revert to standard rates, I'm comfortable endorsing the 35% one-time credit for a strategic win.

Ben
Ben Carter
Sr. Director, Enterprise Sales
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Finance Ops <finance_ops@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Senior sign-off for one-time 35% hosted API retention credit

Stephanie / Ben —

Appreciate the context. A couple of operational asks before I can recommend to Markus for exec approval:
1) Please confirm the exact billing mechanics (credit applied as negative invoices vs. unit price reduction) — finance prefers credits applied as separate line-item credits for audit clarity.
2) Confirm whether the credit is refundable or non-refundable if NimbleHealth churns in the first 90 days. I propose we make it non-refundable and subject to a 30-day clawback if they materially breach volume commitments.
3) Provide a short one-pager (2 bullets + table) showing the 12-month net revenue, gross margin impact, and payback. Use the attached pricing_model tab if helpful.

If we get those clarifications I will escalate to Markus with a recommended approval (conditional on non-refundable wording and clawback language).

Mina Haddad
VP, Revenue Operations
mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Finance Ops <finance_ops@redwoodinference.com>, Legal Ops <legal_ops@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Senior sign-off for one-time 35% hosted API retention credit

Thanks for the clear ask and the supporting numbers. I approve a one-time 35% hosted API usage credit applied across the first three billed months under the following conditions: 

1) Credits will be issued as separate negative-line invoices (Finance Ops to handle) — not as permanent unit price changes.
2) Credits are non-refundable; if NimbleHealth cancels within 90 days or misses the committed volume bands by >30% in the first quarter, we will claw back unamortized credits on a prorated basis.
3) Legal to incorporate the clawback and commit language into the SOW and Master Services Agreement; no evergreen rate changes.
4) Stephanie: require a final one-page net revenue table (per Mina) attached to the approval email before Legal/Finance generate the signature packet.

Assignee: Stephanie to finalize doc + confirm billing mechanics. Finance and Legal — please queue the DocuSign envelope once Stephanie confirms.

Markus
Markus Klein
Chief Revenue Officer (interim)
